Header.description: Vehicle Response Vocabulary Header – Standard CAV-VRV-Vx.y

VRVID.description: Unique identifier of this Vehicle Response Vocabulary instance.

VRVTime.description: Time this Vehicle Response Vocabulary was produced (the end of the measurements).

CAVID.description: Identifier of the CAV whose responses are described.

Surface.description: What the CAV did on each type of road surface it was measured on.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Vehicle Response Vocabulary (plain text, max 2048 characters).

SurfaceType.description: Type of road surface (e.g., dry asphalt, wet asphalt, snow, ice).

Friction.description: Friction coefficient of the surface during the measurements [0..1].

Speed.description: What the CAV did at each of the speeds it was measured at, in ascending order of speed.

Velocity.description: Speed of the CAV when the commands were applied (m/s).

Brake.description: What the CAV did when the brakes were commanded.

Motor.description: What the CAV did when the motor was commanded.

Steering.description: What the CAV did when the road wheels were commanded.

Level.description: The commands applied, in ascending order of deceleration.

MaxDeceleration.description: The largest deceleration the CAV reached, with the wheels not slipping (m/s2).

DeadTime.description: Time from the command to the first change of the acceleration (s).

RiseTime.description: Time from the first change of the acceleration to 90% of its final value (s).

Slipping.description: True if the wheels slipped, i.e. the tyres could not give what was commanded.

Level.description: The commands applied, in ascending order of acceleration.

Coasting.description: Acceleration of the CAV with neither motor nor brakes acting, at this speed (m/s2; negative: it slows down).

MaxAcceleration.description: The largest acceleration the CAV reached, with the wheels not slipping (m/s2).

DeadTime.description: Time from the command to the first change of the acceleration (s).

RiseTime.description: Time from the first change of the acceleration to 90% of its final value (s).

Slipping.description: True if the wheels slipped, i.e. the tyres could not give what was commanded.

Level.description: The commands applied, in ascending order of angle.

MaxLateralAcceleration.description: The largest lateral acceleration the CAV reached while following the road wheels (m/s2).

Command.description: Angle of the road wheels commanded (degrees).

DeadTime.description: Time from the command to the first change of the yaw rate (s).

RiseTime.description: Time from the first change of the yaw rate to 90% of its final value (s).

Settled.description: Yaw rate the CAV settled at (degrees/s).

LateralAcceleration.description: Lateral acceleration at that yaw rate (m/s2).

Following.description: False if the CAV turned less than its road wheels asked, i.e. it was sliding.
